objective: Cross the sea north-west to the Old Dam: Iwao and Chiyo are opening the drowned vault
title: The Drowned Ledger
summary: Under four hundred years of stone lies a door. The Court wants what is behind it, and so, now, does everyone with a spade.

steps.title: The Drowned Ledger
steps.sub: A promise to the people downstream

say: Stone doesn't lie, little one. Every seal I carved last month is sitting on top of a door. I carved a lid onto it.

lines: We found the door at dawn. It is under the spillway, and the water has been keeping it shut the way a hand keeps a mouth shut.
I have heard it every night. A voice that says the same name, over and over, and nobody I know has ever been called it.
Sumi said the Ledger's down there.
Then the Court will be here before the storm breaks. Iwao can lift the slab. It will take a minute, and he will be no use to anyone while he does.
A minute is a long time in a storm. Keep them off my back, {name}. I have done enough harm with these hands.

beats.text: Hold the spillway while Iwao lifts the slab

lines: It's open. There is a book down there as long as my arm.
Please do not touch it. I would rather not have to hurt you for holding something that is already mine to keep.
You wrote my grandfather out of his own dam.
I did not write him out. I only stopped writing him in. There is a difference, and it has not made me sleep any better.

beats.taunt: The water will take the ink anyway. I would only prefer it be mine.

phases.say: Stone, then. Iwao taught the Court that much.
The Ledger names me, too. I am only the last line on the page.

lines: ...Take it. It is heavy, and it is not mine, and I have wanted to put it down for forty years.
Forty years. You were a girl.
I was. I wrote my own name in the first line and then I had no one to forgive me. Read the last page. It is about you, {name}.
That a keeper of the Seal has a name worth taking. And that Mikage will take it at the Five Winds, with the new moon behind her.
The Court's Ledger is in my dam. I never thought I would say that sentence.
Go north. Renji's scouts have gone quiet on the Frozen Road, and the Court's last hunter went through there last night. Go carefully.
